title: Caravan MultiMet: Extending Caravan with Multiple Weather Nowcasts and Forecasts
abstract: arXiv:2411.09459v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The Caravan large-sample hydrology dataset (Kratzert et al., 2023) was created to standardize and harmonize streamflow data from various regional datasets, combined with globally available meteorological forcing and catchment attributes. This community-driven project also allows researchers to conveniently extend the dataset for additional basins, as done 6 times to date (see https://github.com/kratzert/Caravan/discussions/10). We present a novel extension to Caravan, focusing on enriching the meteorological forcing data. Our extension adds three precipitation nowcast products (CPC, IMERG v07 Early, and CHIRPS) and three weather forecast products (ECMWF IFS HRES, GraphCast, and CHIRPS-GEFS) to the existing ERA5-Land reanalysis data. The inclusion of diverse data sources, particularly weather forecasts, enables more robust evaluation and benchmarking of hydrological models, especially for real-time forecasting scenarios. translated_title: Caravan MultiMet：通过多种天气临近预报和预报数据扩展Caravan
translated_abstract: Caravan大样本水文学数据集（Kratzert等人，2023）旨在对来自各种区域数据集的径流数据进行标准化和协调，并将其与全球可用的气象强迫数据和流域属性相结合。这个社区驱动的项目还允许研究人员方便地为额外的流域扩展该数据集，迄今为止已完成6次扩展（见 https://github.com/kratzert/Caravan/discussions/10）。我们提出了Caravan的一项新颖扩展，重点在于丰富气象强迫数据。该扩展在现有的ERA5-Land再分析数据基础上，增加了三种降水临近预报产品（CPC、IMERG v07 Early和CHIRPS）以及三种天气预报产品（ECMWF IFS HRES、GraphCast和CHIRPS-GEFS）。纳入多样化的数据源，尤其是天气预报数据，能够对水文模型进行更稳健的评估和基准测试，特别是在实时预报场景中。据我们所知...
tldr: 本文提出了Caravan水文数据集的新扩展Caravan MultiMet，在ERA5-Land再分析数据基础上增加了三种降水临近预报产品和三种天气预报产品，从而丰富气象强迫数据，支持对水文模型（尤其是实时预报场景）进行更稳健的评估和基准测试。
